outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial cluster image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows H&E images with manual region annotations, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows H&E and spatial expression heatmap images, not a plot of averaged data with summary statistics.

GSEA enrichment plots display running enrichment scores computed from the full ranked gene list rather than an average across discrete replicates/samples, so individual data points are not applicable.

The bar graph shows a single log2 fold-change value per gene derived from differential expression testing (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test) across many spatial spots, not a mean of a small number of replicate measurements, so there are no discrete individual data points to overlay.
